market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is a stable mid-table Premier League club that has not finished lower than 16th since 2010-11 and typically finishes in the top half. Under Graham Potter, with strong financial backing and a solid squad, a relegation in 2025-26 would be a major outlier. The market-implied 34.5% probability is far higher than the actual risk, likely reflecting an inefficiently priced market.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24 and are not among the relegation candidates for 2024-25
Squad value and wage bill are 8th-10th in the league, strong enough to avoid relegation comfortably
Manager Graham Potter has a proven track record of stabilising teams and achieving mid-table finishes
